title: The rule that companions heal at any hearth/fire rest point ('a rest at any hearth heals them') is stated only once, in the very final end-of-game status screen, and is never mentioned during play; for most of the run Brother Osk and Vell sat at partial HP with no earlier hint that resting would top them off.
